name: SSI2130
full_name: FatKeys Voltage Controlled Oscillator (highly integrated analog synth voice front-end)
description: Highly-integrated analog VCO subsystem for electronic musical instruments, generating triangle, sawtooth, buffered PWM-capable pulse, and open-collector square waveforms from a single precision timing capacitor, plus an on-chip sine shaper and a five-channel current-controlled mixer (triangle/saw/pulse plus two auxiliary inputs). A precision analog multiplier gives temperature-compensated exponential control with high frequency-tracking accuracy, and both soft and hard sync plus optional through-zero FM/PM (via the TIME REVERSE pin and external circuitry) are supported. Combine one or more SSI2130s with an SSI2140/SSI2144 VCF and SSI2162/SSI2164 VCA for a complete analog synth voice. Occupies the role classic CEM3340-style discrete/analog VCO cores play in vintage synth voices, though it is an original Sound Semiconductor design (not a pin-for-pin clone) with far greater integration.

pins.name: TRI OUT
pins.description: buffered output of the triangle generator, swings GND to VREF at a rate set by the TCAP capacitor and the current into EXPO FREQ; also fed internally to the mixer

pins.name: SINE IN+
pins.description: noninverting input to the temperature-compensated sine converter; must be connected to GND through a 4.7k ohm resistor for correct operation. For best sine wave, feed TRI OUT through a 10uF cap and 4k ohm resistor into this pin

pins.name: SINE IN-
pins.description: inverting input to the sine converter; same biasing as SINE IN+ but opposite polarity

pins.name: AUX 1 IN
pins.description: auxiliary signal input to the voltage-controlled mixer; 50k ohm input impedance, recommend amplitude under +-2.5V, AC-couple to minimize CV bleedthrough

pins.name: AUX 2 IN
pins.description: second auxiliary signal input to the mixer; same characteristics as AUX 1 IN

pins.name: HF TRACK
pins.description: current output pin used to trim high-frequency tuning error in the exponential converter caused by bulk emitter resistance; two fixed resistors handle most applications, an optional trim improves further. Leave unconnected if unused

pins.name: EXPO FREQ
pins.description: ground-referenced current input to the exponential converter; sensitivity set by current into EXPO SCALE, typically 20uA/octave via a 50k ohm resistor for the common 1V/octave response

pins.name: V-
pins.description: negative supply, -4.75V to -18V; recommend a 100nF local decoupling capacitor close to the package with a low-inductance ground trace

pins.name: TRI MIX
pins.description: control current input setting the mixer level of the internal triangle waveform; 0uA cutoff to 50uA max typical range, 0uA mutes the input

pins.name: SAW MIX
pins.description: control current input setting the mixer level of the internal sawtooth waveform; same 0-50uA range as TRI MIX

pins.name: PULSE MIX
pins.description: control current input setting the mixer level of the internal pulse waveform; same 0-50uA range as TRI MIX

pins.name: AUX 1 MIX
pins.description: control current input setting the mixer level of the AUX 1 IN signal; same 0-50uA range as TRI MIX

pins.name: AUX 2 MIX
pins.description: control current input setting the mixer level of the AUX 2 IN signal; same 0-50uA range as TRI MIX

pins.name: TCAP
pins.description: oscillator timing capacitor to ground; use a low dielectric-absorption, low-tempco type (C0G/NP0 or polystyrene), 3.9nF recommended for standard audio range, usable range 1nF-10nF

pins.name: DGND
pins.description: digital ground for the exponential converter; typically connects to AGND externally

pins.name: AGND
pins.description: analog ground connection for the output stages and mixer

pins.name: HARD SYNC
pins.description: level-sensitive hard sync input; when driven high, internally discharges TCAP to reset the oscillator to the start of its cycle regardless of phase. Connect to ground if unused

pins.name: TIME REVERSE
pins.description: controls direction of the triangle core and slope of the sawtooth generator; tied to V+ gives rising-saw-with-fast-fall, tied to ground gives fast-rise-with-falling-saw. Toggling at audio rates produces through-zero FM tones

pins.name: SOFT SYNC
pins.description: connects to an internal 5k ohm resistor setting the triangle's lower threshold; an AC-coupled pulse here makes the falling slope of the triangle reverse direction. No effect if TCAP is at or below the sync pulse level. Leave unconnected if unused

pins.name: HFT BASE
pins.description: direct connection to the base of the internal high-frequency trim transistor; connect to ground for normal operation

pins.name: LIN FREQ
pins.description: ground-referenced current input setting the linear scale of the exponential converter's output; used for linear FM, or together with TIME REVERSE for through-zero FM. Tie to a constant ~5uA (e.g. via 499k ohm from VREF) if linear FM is not used

pins.name: EXPO SCALE
pins.description: ground-referenced current input setting the sensitivity (scale) of the EXPO FREQ pin; feed 94.34uA in for the common 20uA/octave sensitivity

pins.name: VREF
pins.description: reference voltage input; must be externally fixed at 2.5V (0.5% tolerance) from a low-noise, low-impedance voltage reference. Sets waveform amplitude and critical EXPO SCALE/LIN FREQ current scaling

pins.name: SINE OUT
pins.description: voltage output of the sine converter; range -VREF to +VREF volts when driven from TRI OUT, 10k ohm recommended load

pins.name: MIX OUT
pins.description: high-compliance current output of the internal 5-channel mixer; drive a resistor to convert to voltage, or feed directly into a ground-referenced current input such as an SSI2140 VCF or SSI2164 VCA

pins.name: BW COMP
pins.description: frequency compensation node for the exponential converter; connect a 270 ohm resistor in series with a 10nF capacitor to ground

pins.name: V+
pins.description: positive supply, must be a regulated +4.75V to +5.25V (+5.0V typ) source; recommend a 100nF local decoupling capacitor close to the package with a low-inductance ground trace

pins.name: SQUARE OUT
pins.description: open-collector output from the oscillator's internal S-R flip-flop; requires an external pullup resistor to V+ (or a lower rail), high impedance when not pulled low. Leave unconnected if unused

pins.name: SAW OUT
pins.description: output of the internal triangle-to-sawtooth converter, range 0V to VREF. Direction set by TIME REVERSE: floating/V+ gives slow rise/fast fall, grounded gives fast rise/slow fall. Also fed internally to the mixer

pins.name: PULSE OUT
pins.description: output of an internal comparator producing a variable-width pulse; driven hard to ground or VREF depending on the PWM+/PWM- comparator inputs. Also fed to the internal mixer

pins.name: PWM-
pins.description: inverting input of the internal PWM comparator; input range 0V to VREF, typically driven by the buffered triangle/saw

pins.name: PWM+
pins.description: noninverting input of the internal PWM comparator; input range 0V to VREF, typically driven by a wiper/pot or voltage source to set pulse width

QFN-32.notes: Per Sound Semiconductor's own PIN CONNECTIONS diagram and SSI2130 PIN DESCRIPTIONS table (Rev 2.4, December 2020), 32-lead 4x4mm QFN, top view. QFN has a standard exposed metal thermal pad on the underside (SSI package ID PQN32); per the datasheet, if a corresponding PCB land pad is used it must NOT have any electrical or ground connection.

extra.supply topology: asymmetric split supply: V+ regulated +4.75 to +5.25V (typ +5.0V, abs max +5.25V); V- flexible -4.75 to -18V (abs max -18V)
extra.VREF: must be fixed at 2.5V +-0.5% (2.49-2.51V) from a low-noise low-impedance reference; 100uA max current draw
extra.exponential conformity: 0.3% typ (calibrated per datasheet Expo Setup procedure)
extra.triangle output: 0V (GND) to VREF swing, 6mA max source / 1mA max sink
extra.sawtooth output: 0V to VREF swing, 6mA max source/sink, 1.6us typ discharge time
extra.pulse output/PWM: 0V to VREF swing, 6mA max source current, rise time 70ns typ, fall time 125ns typ, PWM bias current 40nA typ
extra.square output: open-collector; VOL 80mV typ at 5mA sink, fall time 37ns typ; needs external pullup
extra.sine shaper: differential input +-2.5V into SINE IN+/-, bias current 20nA typ; output swing +-2.5V into 10k ohm load; THD+N 0.76% typ @1kHz, 22Hz-22kHz, 1.7Vrms; output offset 3mV typ
extra.mixer (audio): aux input handling +-2.5V, 50k ohm typ input impedance, recommended max output current 500uA, output noise -106dBu (20Hz-20kHz, 1% THD), THD+N 0.3% typ @1kHz, 1Vrms
extra.mixer (control): mute attenuation 100dB typ, 0uA control current at full attenuation, 50uA recommended max control current, control feedthrough -60dB typ
extra.timing capacitor: 3.9nF recommended (C0G/NP0 or polystyrene) for standard music-synth audio range; usable range 1nF-10nF

typical_application: Core analog VCO of a synth voice: pair with an SSI2140/SSI2144 VCF and SSI2162/SSI2164 VCA for a complete voice. Generates triangle, sawtooth, PWM pulse, open-collector square, and (via the built-in sine shaper) sine waveforms from one timing capacitor, plus a 5-channel current-controlled mixer for combining internal waveforms with two auxiliary inputs before feeding a downstream filter or VCA.
gotchas: asymmetric split supply: V+ must be a regulated +5V rail (+4.75 to +5.25V), while V- is flexible from -4.75V to -18V; do not assume symmetric rails

VREF (pin 23) is not internally generated -- it must be driven externally with a stable, low-noise, low-impedance 2.5V reference held within 0.5%, since it sets waveform amplitude and the EXPO SCALE/LIN FREQ current scaling
SQUARE OUT (pin 28) is open-collector and floats/high-Z unless pulled up externally to V+ (or another suitable rail)
TCAP (pin 14) needs a low-dielectric-absorption, low-tempco capacitor (C0G/NP0 or polystyrene); using a generic ceramic will hurt tuning stability
the QFN's exposed thermal pad provides no real thermal benefit at this power level -- if a matching PCB land pad is included, it must NOT have any electrical or ground connection

the mixer's MIX/CONTROL pins (9-13) expect ground-referenced control currents (typ 0-50uA via 100k ohm resistors for a 0-5V CV range), not direct voltage drive; do not tie them straight to ground if unused, use a resistor no less than 50k ohm
sold only directly by Sound Semiconductor and its authorized resellers, not a general second-sourced part
